items.title: Organic Crack Texture DXF Panel for Abstract Art Screens
items.description: Three fractured, cell-like circular clusters break across the panel like cracked stone or tree bark, giving an organic, artistic texture. This abstract motif works well for gallery walls, feature screens, and modern outdoor art panels.

items.title: Abstract Falling Rain Geometric Graded Slit Matrix
items.description: A sleek, ultra-modern privacy screen featuring a graded matrix of vertical dashed lines resembling falling rain or pixelated static. The pattern transitions smoothly from an open, dense mesh at the bottom to a solid, high-privacy field at the top.
